Starting the counseling process is a wonderful step toward taking care of your mental well-being. A good first step is to think about what you would like to focus on, such as managing stress, navigating a life transition, or addressing specific feelings. From there, you can look into your options based on your budget and location. If you have health insurance, checking their directory for in-network providers is often the easiest way to begin. You can also explore online therapist directories, community mental health centers, or Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs) if your workplace offers one.

Once you find a few potential counselors, you can reach out via phone or email to ask if they are accepting new clients. Many therapists offer a free, brief consultation to see if you are a good fit for each other. Remember that it is completely normal to speak with a few different professionals before finding the one who makes you feel the most comfortable and understood.
